name: Wellbeing Digital Sciences Inc.
summary: With its origins as KetamineOne Capital Limited, this innovative wellness organization is dedicated to advancing ketamine-assisted therapy and psychedelic medicines. It achieves this mission by managing a network of healthcare clinics across North America. The company, which commenced operations in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, was formerly recognized as Myconic Capital Corp. Its transition to the KetamineOne Capital Limited name occurred in June 2021.
